transcriptAssembly.rule: Word-level recognized text in reading order. Words are sorted by vertical centre, and by left edge when vertical centres are within 20 px, which is the repository's existing reading-order rule.

steps: replace every character outside [a-z0-9 ] with a space
collapse runs of whitespace to one ASCII space

collapsedForm: the normalized string with all spaces removed; used for substring and character-error-rate comparisons

metrics.exactNormalizedMatch: normalized transcript equals a normalized acceptable truth value
metrics.characterErrorRate: Levenshtein(collapsed hypothesis, collapsed truth) / length(collapsed truth); best over acceptable truth values
metrics.usefulTokenRecall: truth tokens of length >= 3 after normalization; fraction appearing as substrings of the collapsed hypothesis
metrics.truthPresentInRaw: collapsed truth is a substring of the collapsed raw transcript
metrics.truthBearingFragmentCount: count of matched truth tokens of length >= 3
metrics.hallucinatedText: not automatically adjudicable; left null with an explicit note rather than guessed

improvementThresholds.rule: Improvement requires truth-bearing gain: a newly exact normalized match, truth newly present in the raw transcript, a useful-token-recall gain of at least 0.25 that also adds at least one whole truth token, or a character-error-rate reduction of at least 0.10. More characters, higher confidence, non-empty output, or merely different output never count as improvement.

confidenceHandling.reason: tesseract.js and native Tesseract confidence scales are not proven comparable, so no normalized confidence field is fabricated.
